item: Provide HVDC power to propulsion system and batteries
function: Provide HVDC power to propulsion system and batteries
failure_mode: Turboshaft engine fails to provide output shaft power to gearbox
local_effect: Loss of Engine power output to gearbox, AC generator and accessory loads
next_level_effect: Loss of electrical power to drive motors and accessory loads. Batteries provide electric power for 2 minutes.
end_effect: Loss of all propulsion after battery power is depleted. Loss of aircraft if pilot cannot find safe landing area and land within 2 minutes.

controls.description: Visual and audible warning provided to pilot. Pilot detects abnormal engine noise
